links.note: OVERWRITE of 31543 'His own family saved', which is Sanjeev's rescue of his wife and baby daughter, not Ignesious's. Who Ignesious got out - three children, having lost two to the grandfather-and-uncle rush and his wife to the wave - is 31542 'Which way they ran'.

OVERWRITE of 31552 'A family on holiday', which only names the Smiths, their ages and where they were. The item tests that it was Tilly, not either parent, who recognised the tsunami, and the child-reads-it/adult-cannot contrast is 31553. The set has no concept for the geography lesson itself.
